contracts.title: Documented affordability barrier
contracts.purpose: Find supported source reports for assistance review; current need, consent and program eligibility remain separate.
contracts.supported_next_step: Review the documented barrier, confirm current need and assess assistance-specific consent and eligibility.

contracts.title: Dated nephrology plan and completion accounts
contracts.purpose: Reconcile evidence of a plan and completed care without assuming that an attendance account fulfills a particular referral.
contracts.supported_next_step: Inspect both dated accounts and reconcile referral/attendance identity and ordering before declaring a referral fulfilled.

contracts.title: Received affordability-screen reports
contracts.purpose: Find literal reported difficulty paying medical bills in received source accounts. A billing balance does not establish hardship; a positive screen does not establish current need or program eligibility.
contracts.supported_next_step: Review the dated screen and confirm current need, consent and assistance-program criteria.

contracts.title: Medication non-use source reports
contracts.purpose: Find a selected medication account reporting not_using, retaining separate prescription identities, unresolved timing and conflicting reports. This is a report-review signal, not established nonadherence or a treatment decision.
contracts.supported_next_step: Reconcile the named prescription, reported timing, current use and the reason for non-use before recommending a change.

contracts.title: Linked outside-service documentation
contracts.purpose: Find received status accounts that explicitly document an outside service, with their referral and imported-record dependencies present. This does not prove that a clinically indicated service or a particular program requirement was fulfilled.

documentation.label: Outside-service account with received source links

contracts.supported_next_step: Review the linked referral and imported record for exact service, patient, date and clinical relevance.

contracts.title: Advance-care document validity review
contracts.purpose: Find received advance-care document accounts explicitly stating that legal validity was not determined. Their transcribed treatment fields do not authorize a code-status or goals-of-care decision.
contracts.supported_next_step: Verify the source document, version, signatures, applicability and patient preferences through the appropriate review process.

contracts.title: Medication use and hold report readiness
contracts.purpose: Determine whether beta-blocker reported-use and hold/stop accounts have resolved documentary polarity. Either positive or negative reports can supply review inputs; no medication decision follows from this contract.
contracts.supported_next_step: Reconcile exact medication identity, chronology, current use and hold rationale; dose tolerance and clinical appropriateness remain separate.

contracts.title: Medication regimen confirmation review
contracts.purpose: Find explicit review entries requesting regimen confirmation, linked to the reported product, interview, historical list and pharmacy response. These are documentary review needs, not medication changes.

label_requires_confirmation.label: historical dispensing label available current regimen requires confirmation

contracts.supported_next_step: Inspect the item-level source chain and clarify current use, directions and the remaining source discrepancies before considering treatment changes.

contracts.title: Linked medication dispensing-label reports
contracts.purpose: Find review entries explicitly reporting a dispensing label, retaining the exact response item, received copy and original dispense. This does not verify current directions or ingestion.
contracts.supported_next_step: Inspect the item-level source chain and clarify current use, directions and the remaining source discrepancies before considering treatment changes.

contracts.title: Received requests for prescriber reassessment
contracts.purpose: Identify a received response explicitly requesting reassessment, with its linked request intact. No prescription, stop instruction, current medication use or completed reassessment is inferred.
contracts.supported_next_step: Inspect the exact request and response and reconcile current medication information before any clinical decision.

contracts.title: Received renewal deferrals for clarification
contracts.purpose: Identify a received prescriber account that explicitly defers renewal pending clarification. This is documentary status, not an independent recommendation to hold or restart therapy.
contracts.supported_next_step: Review the named medication, laboratory links, reported supply and stated clarification need with the prescriber.

contracts.title: Reported transport difficulty
contracts.purpose: Find affirmative transport difficulty reports in received interviews. Historical reports, contact permission, eligibility, current need and completed services remain separate.
contracts.supported_next_step: Confirm the reported transport need and contact permission, then inspect available resources and their own eligibility requirements.

contracts.title: Received community-service delivery reports
contracts.purpose: Find linked received accounts explicitly reporting service delivery. Scheduling alone is not delivery; missing reports do not establish that care did not occur.
contracts.supported_next_step: Review the linked referral and delivery account, including the exact service and date; do not infer broader program completion.
